meta.title: Delta Desktop
meta.description: Delta Desktop native DeepSeek Harness plugin with extensible appearance and settings.

ui.preference: Switch theme without disabling the official layout, sessions or plugins.
ui.unavailable: A required capability is unavailable or an action failed. Disable this plugin to restore the official UI.
ui.recovery: If Settings cannot open, disable dsh-delta-desktop in the Host Profile and restart.
ui.shortcut: The official layout owns shortcuts; this plugin does not override existing keys.
ui.personalizationDescription: Switch between Delta theme and official theme.
ui.appearanceDescription: Switch between Delta theme and official theme without changing sessions, models or plugins.
ui.hostOwned: Session search and workspace operations are proxied to native Harness services and revert completely when disabled.
ui.protectedDefaultWorkspace: The default workspace is protected and cannot be deleted.
ui.signOutFromMenu: Please sign out from the account menu
ui.cannotDeleteSoleWorkspace: The sole remaining workspace cannot be deleted.

sessionMenu.moveDescription: Choose a target workspace. The session will move cleanly and persist across restarts.
sessionMenu.moveEmpty: No other workspace available yet. Add another workspace first.
sessionMenu.deleteDescription: Permanently delete “{title}”? Local conversation history will be removed.
sessionMenu.deleteUngroupedDescription: Permanently delete {count} ungrouped session(s)? Local history will be removed and empty Ungrouped will hide automatically.
sessionMenu.deleteUngroupedLockedWarning: {locked} locked session(s) will remain protected until unlocked.
sessionMenu.unlockFirst: This session is locked. Unlock it first.
sessionMenu.setPinTitle: Set up 2FA code to lock sessions
sessionMenu.setPinDescription: Scan the QR code or enter the secret key in an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code. Locked chats move automatically to Archive.
sessionMenu.pinMismatch: 2FA setup expired. Please reopen and try again.
sessionMenu.wrongPin: Invalid or expired 6-digit code. Please try again.
sessionMenu.lockedShieldDesc: Enter the 6-digit 2FA code to view this session temporarily or unlock and unarchive it permanently.
sessionMenu.lockedToast: Session locked and moved to Archive
sessionMenu.clearPinDesc: Enter your current 6-digit 2FA code to remove protection and restore all locked sessions from Archive.
sessionMenu.pinClearedToast: Session lock 2FA unbound and locked sessions restored
sessionMenu.totpInitFailed: Unable to initialize 2FA setup. Ensure the desktop host is running.

networkProxy.title: Network Proxy
networkProxy.description: Controls outbound network connectivity for DeepSeek Harness model APIs, web_fetch, and Host plugins.
networkProxy.httpsProxyPlaceholder: Leave blank to reuse HTTP Proxy
networkProxy.invalidUrl: Invalid proxy URL. Use an http:// or https:// URL.
networkProxy.socksUnsupported: Host fetch proxy only supports http:// or https:// schemes.
networkProxy.note: Controls all Host model requests, web_fetch, and plugin outbound HTTP; without editing the main binary, the embedded Chromium browser keeps system default.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Minimization
privacy.description: Enforces zero Session Log upload/viewing/export, blocks telemetry/crash reporting, and keeps geolocation disabled by default.
privacy.sessionLogBlocked: Session Log collection, viewing & export disabled
privacy.geolocationOff: Geolocation permission off by default (denied unless authorized)
privacy.redactionActive: Sensitive text redaction & in-memory search minimization active

searchPalette.placeholder: Search sessions, message text, workspaces, plugins, skills, or shortcuts…
searchPalette.noResultsHint: Search across session titles, message text, workspaces, installed plugins, skills, and shortcuts
